name: Mayo Business Plan Competition — required submission components
completeness_note: The schedule page states the deliverables, the plan's required sections, and the length limits. It does not state the registration form's own fields, and the full guidebook at https://mbpc.tcnj.edu/2025-2026-mbpc-guidebook/ was not transcribed. The plan sections below are the components the page lists as required inside the business plan document, not separate form questions.

fields.label: Business Plan (PDF)
fields.stated_limit: Maximum plan length: 20 pages, double-spaced 11 or 12 font; additional charts and tables (maximum five pages)
fields.help_text: Page states: "Plan must be submitted as a PDF (not a Word or Excel file)". Due date on the page: 1/08/27 by 11:59 pm, "Absolute due date; no exceptions".

fields.label: Executive Summary
fields.help_text: Listed by the page as a required component of the business plan document.

fields.label: A short pitch video (1 to 3 minutes) describing the concept and likely target market(s) is required
Affirmation of Policy Statement
fields.help_text: An affirmation the applicant makes at registration. Section 10.1 category: attestation. The agent must never complete it.
